news.headline: Saints sign 12 players to the practice squad
news.summary: New Orleans filled its 12-spot practice squad on Monday, one day after cutting down to 53 players. Running back Zamir White and kicker Charlie Smyth are both back after being let go on Sunday.

news.headline: Saints claim two linemen off waivers
news.summary: New Orleans added defensive tackle Colby Wooden from the Colts and offensive tackle Mason Murphy from the Bears on Monday. Both had been let go by their old teams in the league-wide cuts on Sunday.

news.headline: Saints set their 53-man roster for the season
news.summary: New Orleans got down to the 53 players the league allows on Sunday. The team let go of 19 players and put five more on injured reserve.

news.headline: Florida posts its first lineup chart of the year
news.summary: The Gators listed their starters Monday for Saturday's opener against Florida Atlantic. Aaron Philo is the quarterback and Jadan Baugh is the running back, while three players are still competing for the last spot on the defensive line.

news.headline: Sumrall says Florida will not add former pro players
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Friday that his roster is full and he is not signing anyone who has played pro football. He said that once a player goes pro, that ship has sailed.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall named Philo his starting quarterback on Monday. Philo transferred in from Georgia Tech and beat out Tramell Jones Jr. for the job.

news.headline: Kiffin will not show his lineup until game day
news.summary: LSU will not hand out its list of starters until Saturday, an hour-of-the-game change from past coaches. Lane Kiffin said Monday that most spots are settled except defensive tackle, where he plans to rotate players.

news.headline: Kiffin waits on a court ruling before setting his roster
news.summary: Two players who had been in the NFL are practicing with LSU but cannot be on the game roster yet. A judge hears the case Thursday, and LSU has to turn in its roster Friday, one day before it plays Clemson.

news.headline: Tampa Bay cuts Jack Pyburn, who could return to LSU
news.summary: The Buccaneers waived the linebacker on Sunday after he had four sacks in the preseason. If no other pro team picks him up, he is free to play for LSU again.

news.headline: Tulane practices on grass to get ready for Duke
news.summary: The Green Wave held their last tune-up practice Friday at the Saints facility so they could work on a real grass field. Duke's stadium has grass, and Tulane opens there on September 5.

news.headline: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion will start at quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall picked Chriss-Gremillion to start Tulane's opener at Duke on September 5. He has started 13 college games, first at Louisiana and then at Houston.

news.headline: Two quarterbacks lead the way in last scrimmage
news.summary: Kadin Semonza and Zeon Chriss-Gremillion took most of the first-team snaps in Tulane's final scrimmage on Saturday at Yulman Stadium. Coach Will Hall said he will name his starting quarterback on Monday.
